title: Specials page offers appear image-based with only generic disclaimers in text
quote: [Generic MSRP and selling price disclaimers only — no actual lease/finance offers visible in page text. Total text content: 2,945 chars]. Offers may be presented as images or via /inventory/close-out-specials/.
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — Automated crawl found only two generic MSRP/selling-price disclaimers and zero actual lease or finance offers in the page text. If offers are presented as images (common for OEM-fed lease specials), any payment, APR, or term claims rendered inside image creatives must still meet California clear-and-conspicuous standards and contain the full set of required offer disclosures (lessee, term, due-at-signing, mileage limits, expiration, residual, etc.). Please visually verify whether the page renders payment offers as images, and confirm each image carries adequate on-creative disclosures or a clearly linked, proximate text disclaimer. The two generic disclaimers currently present are not offer-specific and would not cure deficient per-offer disclosures.

title: Specials disclaimers lack expiration dates or offer-specific terms
quote: Offers, incentives, discounts, or financing are subject to expiration and other restrictions. See dealer for qualifications and complete details.
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The page-level disclaimers reference "expiration and other restrictions" generically but do not surface specific offer expiration dates in the text crawl. If individual specials carry advertised end dates inside image creatives, ensure each offer's expiration is clearly and conspicuously stated in proximity to the offer. Add a visible expiration date per offer rather than relying on a global "subject to expiration" footnote.

title: Used vehicle pages do not reference 3-day cancellation right
quote: Used Inventory for Sale | Anaheim, CA
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — Used VLP text extraction returned empty (likely dynamic inventory grid), so the audit could not confirm whether any reference to the CARS Act 3-day cancellation right appears on used inventory pages. The CARS Act primary disclosure is at point of sale, so absence on the website is a best-practice concern rather than a violation — unless the site contains contradictory "all sales final" or waiver language (which the audit also could not assess from the empty extract). Please visually verify the used VLP/VDP and any FAQ or sales-policy pages: (1) confirm no "all sales final" or similar contradictory language is present on qualifying used vehicles ($50K or less), and (2) consider adding a brief reference to the consumer's 3-day cancellation right with accurate statutory terms (3 calendar days, $50K threshold, 1.5% / $200–$600 restocking fee cap, 400-mile limit).

title: Hero banner disclaimers gated behind click-to-expand 'Show Disclaimer' button
quote: Multiple rotating hero banners with 'Show Disclaimer' click-to-expand buttons.
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — Homepage hero banners require a user click to reveal disclaimers. Click-to-expand disclosure patterns are a common Stellantis DAP / California "clear and conspicuous" concern because reasonable consumers may interact with the offer (CTA click) without ever opening the disclosure. Please visually verify: (1) the relative prominence of the "Show Disclaimer" affordance vs. the offer claim, (2) whether the offers being qualified are factual/quantitative (payment, APR, savings amount) — which would heighten the concern — vs. generic puffery, and (3) whether rotating banner timing allows enough time for a consumer to open and read the disclosure before the next slide. Consider inline always-visible disclosure text beneath the hero claim instead of a click-to-expand pattern.

title: Closeout specials page mistitled 'Certified Pre Owned Chrysler Dodge Jeep RAM'
quote: Certified Pre Owned Chrysler Dodge Jeep RAM
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The page title for /inventory/close-out-specials/ reads "Certified Pre Owned Chrysler Dodge Jeep RAM," which is inconsistent with the URL and apparent purpose (new vehicle closeout specials). Using "Certified Pre Owned" branding on a non-CPO page risks both consumer confusion and a Stellantis CPO branding compliance issue (STEL-CPO-001 limits Certified branding to vehicles in the official Stellantis CPO program). Update the page <title> and any meta tags to accurately describe the closeout specials inventory, and reserve "Certified Pre-Owned" language for the dedicated CPO page once those vehicles are enrolled in the Stellantis CPO program.
